title: Automation rules
empty: No rules yet. Create one below.

fields.name: Name
fields.recordIdField: Payload field holding the record id, e.g. orderId
fields.body: Note text. Use {field} for payload values
fields.ownerField: Payload field holding the owner id (optional)
fields.cancelPrevious: Cancel earlier plan runs on the record first
fields.updates: Fields to set, one per line: field=value

hints.condition: Leave the field empty to run on every event. Amounts are compared as numbers.
hints.time: Runs once per record, the first day the date plus the delay has passed. Use the record column name, for example stage_entered_at.
hints.updates: Allowed fields: lead channel, expected_close_date, probability, status (not lost or won). Contract: bo_owner_id, decision_reason, next_action, bank_name, bank_reference, central_risk_result. Contract state cannot be set here.
hints.steps: Each step: {"action": "post_note", "config": {...}}. Up to 10 steps, no nested multi.

errors.invalid: The rule is not valid. Check the fields.
errors.timeConfig: Choose a record type and a date field allowed for it.

forbidden: You do not have access to automation.
